ABOUT KRISTU JAYANTI (DEEMED TO BE UNIVERSITY)
KRISTU JAYANTI (DEEMED TO BE UNIVERSITY), BENGALURU, CARRIES FORWARD THE
EDUCATIONAL VISION OF ST. KURIAKOSE ELIAS CHAVARA (18O5-1871), FOUNDER OF THE
RELIGIOUS CONGREGATION CARMELITES OF MARY IMMACULATE (CMD. HIS VISION CENTRED
ON THE RENEWAL OF HUMANITY THROUGH THE INTEGRAL DEVELOPMENT OF MIND, BODY,
AND SPIRIT.
THE UNIVERSITY MOTTO, "LIGHT AND PROSPERITY," REFLECTS THIS PURSUIT OF HARMONY
ACROSS THE SPIRITUAL, PHYSICAL, INTELLECTUAL, AND HUMAN DIMENSIONS OF
DEVELOPMENT, KRISTU JAYANTI (DEEMED TO BE UNIVERSITY) WAS REACCREDITED BY NAAC
WITH AN 'A++’ GRADE IN 2021,
RECENTLY RECOGNISED WITH “DEEMED TO BE UNIVERSITY" STATUS, KRISTU JAYANTI
CONTINUES TO ESTABLISH ITSELF AS A PREMIER DESTINATION FOR WORLD-CLASS
EDUCATION. ITS ACADEMIC STANDING IS REINFORCED BY NATIONAL RECOGNITION
INCLUDING #1 AMONG INDIA'S TOP 1O EMERGING COLLEGES IN COMMERCE IN THE INDIA
TODAY-MDRA SURVEY 2O25 AND 18TH NATIONALLY IN COMMERCE IN THE WEEK-HANSA

ABOUT THE DEPARTMENT
The Department of Professional Accounting and Finance (DPAF) is a centre of
excellence focused on preparing professionals for the global business and
financial landscape. Designed for ambitious learners seeking more than a
conventional commerce degree, the Department offers four-year undergraduate
programmes that integrate globally recognized professional qualifications,
including CA, ACCA, CPA, and CFA, within the Bachelor of Commerce framework.
DPAF develops expertise across professional accounting, international finance,
business analytics, investment banking, taxation, and strategic reporting,
aligning academic preparation with evolving industry requirements and global
career opportunities. Its strength rests on a professionally integrated
curriculum, highly qualified faculty with academic and industry expertise,
strong industry collaborations, and a clear focus on employability, global
mobility, and holistic development.
Students engage with research-driven teaching, continuous mentorship, and
accelerated career pathways. Amid rapid economic and technological
transformation, DPAF equips students with the competence, confidence, and
global perspective required to build careers across Accounting, Finance,
Analytics, Taxation, Audit, and Investment Banking worldwide.

ABOUT IMPERIUM 2.0
IlMPERlUM 2.0 is a national-level research paper presentation competition built
around the theme “Systems That Shape Our Future" Modern enterprise
operates within interconnected structural frameworks-from algorithmic
governance and carbon compliance to global financial networks. IMPERlUM 2.0
gives student scholars a rigorous platform to move beyond surface-level
business pitches and present, validate, and defend their research findings
before expert jury panels.
Dual-Stream Eguity: The 6-Track Champions Model
To eliminate unfair advantages between on-campus and remote participants,
IMPERIUM 2.0 operates through a parallel-stream format. With 3 dedicated
Offline Tracks and 3 dedicated Online Tracks, every presentation is evaluated
strictly within its selected mode. Virtual presenters never compete directly
against on-campus presenters. This eliminates stream dilution and gives
teams 6× the opportunity to claim a national title across the six independent
tracks.
WHO SHOULD PARTICIPATE & ELIGIBILITY
Target Audience: Open to All Undergraduate (UG) and Postgraduate (PG)
students across all streams
Team Structure: Strictly Teams of 2 members.
